critical_code_review_comments: services/meta_feed_mapper.py _is_valid_image_url — clean layered check: (1) https required, (2) presigned marker set (X-Amz-Signature, X-Goog-Signature) rejects before any extension logic, (3) banned extension set (.webp/.svg/.heic/.heif) short-circuits, (4) Facebook click redirects rejected, (5) extensionless URLs admitted (path segment without dot). Correctly rejects the presigned S3 pattern that would 403 the crawler and drop the product from the Meta catalog. Deliberate crawler-fetch-time content-type resolution for extensionless CDN URLs — right trade-off.

services/google_feed_mapper.py _sanitize_google_image_url — mirrors meta validation; also strips query string on admitted URLs so Google Merchant Center receives canonical URLs (imgix ?w=1200 collapses to plain path). Rejected URLs return empty string not None so downstream <g:image_link> emission can safely fall through to placeholder logic.

routes/contractor_ivr_inbound.py POST/GET /api/twilio/ivr/main-menu — accepts BOTH POST (Twilio) AND GET (Twilio Console config probe) — good defensive design. First POST hit persists inbound_extension_calls row with menu_variant='iter347_single_step' for auditing. attempt query param drives (1) initial menu, (2) bilingual 'didn't catch / capté' retry nudge, (≥3) support fallback that guarantees the call is NEVER dropped. <Gather input='dtmf' numDigits='4' finishOnKey='#' timeout='8' method='POST'> is the correct shape (1-4 digits, # completes early, 8s idle).

routes/contractor_ivr_inbound.py POST /api/twilio/handle-menu — dispatcher: Digits=='1' → dial +15149490038 support; 4-digit → lookup_contractor_by_extension(db, ext, role='dialer_contractor') then <Dial callerId='+14506343099'><Number>{personal_phone_number}</Number></Dial> (privacy: caller sees BidVex main line, not the contractor's personal cell); unknown ext OR no input → <Redirect> to /main-menu?attempt=N+1 so caller replay the menu — NEVER hangs up. This is the correct contact-center pattern.

Content-Type header on TwiML endpoints is 'application/xml' without ';charset=utf-8' suffix — requests' chardet fallback then mis-detects pure ASCII as CJK and str-decodes with mojibake. Tests correctly use response.content.decode('utf-8'). Consider (nit only): explicitly setting media_type='application/xml; charset=utf-8' in the FastAPI Response to eliminate the chardet trap for any future integrators.

rca of the issue: Not applicable — new-feature verification, no bug RCA needed. ISSUE 1 root cause of the pre-iter347 regression was over-strict _is_valid_image_url that required both https AND a valid image extension in the URL PATH — modern CloudFront/S3 URLs increasingly have no extension (Content-Type resolved at HTTP fetch time), so those were silently discarded and every listing served only the branded BidVex placeholder in Meta+Google feeds. Fix: (a) admit extensionless URLs, (b) explicitly reject presigned URLs (X-Amz-Signature / X-Goog-Signature) since those expire and would 403 the crawler, (c) explicitly reject .webp/.svg/.heic/.heif and http:// and Facebook click redirects. ISSUE 2 replaces an earlier multi-step IVR with a cleaner single-step 'press 1 for support OR enter a 4-digit extension' Gather block that dispatches via /handle-menu — bilingual EN+FR, bilingual retry nudge on attempt=2, graceful support fallback on attempt≥3 so the call is NEVER dropped.
